_comment: Applied by vm/metabase_content.py (D109). Times are relative to the latest day in the data, not today: the data ends on the seed day.
name: Goat Arcade at a glance
description: The whole chain in one screen: last week's cash, games and members, cash per venue, what earns, and where the venues are. 'Last week' is the last full Monday-to-Sunday week in the data.

cards.name: Cash counted, last week
cards.description: Cash counted from all machines in the last full week, against the week before.
sql: SELECT week_start AS week, sum(amount_eur) AS cash_eur
GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

cards.name: Games played, last week
cards.description: Games on all machines in the last full week, against the week before.
sql: WITH lw AS (SELECT (date_trunc('week', max(day) + 1) - interval '7 days')::date AS w FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT date_trunc('week', p.day)::date AS week, sum(p.games) AS games
WHERE p.day >= lw.w - 7 AND p.day < lw.w + 7

cards.name: Active members, last 7 days
cards.description: Members (card holders) whose last game was in the 7 days up to the latest day in the data. The views keep only each member's last game, so there is no week-before comparison.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)

cards.name: Cash counted per venue, 26 weeks
cards.description: Weekly cash count per venue over the last 26 full weeks.
sql: SELECT week_start AS week, venue_name AS venue, amount_eur AS cash_eur

cards.name: Venues on the map
cards.description: Where the venues are, with the cash counted in the last 4 full weeks (click a pin).
sql: SELECT v.venue_name AS venue, v.city, v.lat, v.lon, v.machines, coalesce(c.cash_eur, 0) AS cash_4_weeks_eur
LEFT JOIN (SELECT venue_code, sum(amount_eur) AS cash_eur FROM annex_api.revenue_weekly
GROUP BY venue_code) c ON c.venue_code = v.venue_code

cards.name: Estimated revenue by era, 90 days
cards.description: Estimated revenue (credits times price) of pinball machines by era, and of video and other machines, over the last 90 days.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT coalesce(p.era, p.machine_type) AS era, sum(p.revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur

cards.name: Top 10 machines by revenue, 30 days
cards.description: The ten machines with the most estimated revenue in the last 30 days, with the venue where they last played.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT p.title || ' #' || p.machine_id || ' (' || (array_agg(p.venue_code ORDER BY p.day DESC))[1] || ')' AS machine,
sum(p.revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, sum(p.games) AS games
